visual_thesis: A plausible diagnosis is only an intermediate state. At 320px follow diagnosis, challenge and engineer review; at full size inspect onset, affected requests, rollout evidence and the recovery return path.
mechanism_metaphor: One continuous horseshoe investigation track, with an enlarged open diagnostic lens at upper-left exposing three clearly different evidence facets: onset trace, affected-request group and deployment comparison. A smaller opposing lens challenges the diagnosis at upper-center. A plain engineer-review boundary sits upper-right before an unmarked deployment joint. A recovery comparator occupies lower-right: two unnumbered trace fragments in a common frame, conceptual not measured. A single return arc runs below to the initial diagnostic port if recovery is absent. No extra arrowheads beyond the four frozen edges. Show thirteen useful parts: onset trace, affected group, rollout strip, diagnosis junction, counterfactual specimen, reviewer lens, challenged hypothesis, review boundary, deployment joint, earlier-state trace, affected-state trace, recovery comparator and return loop. Thin leader lines without heads associate evidence facets and label objects, never imply additional causal routes.

MEDIUM: Fine red and charcoal technical pen with selective translucent vermilion washes. VIEW: Elevated continuous horseshoe section. PALETTE: Vermilion graphite white. No people, humanoids, faces, logos, photography, product gloss, shields, gears, control knobs, dashboards, generic cards, scenery or unsupported chart marks. Crisp professional linework, meaningful internal stages and strong silhouette with breathing room.
